description: Golden retrieval QA set. Each item: a realistic student question, the tutorial that contains the answer, and the week the student is in (for curriculum-filter testing). Mix of verbatim-term and paraphrased questions.

How many operations do nested loops cost?
State the Master Theorem cases.
How does merge sort split and combine the array?

Why does searching a sorted array only take logarithmic time?
What is the exchange argument used for in greedy proofs?
How do I pick the maximum number of non-overlapping activities?
When can I take fractions of items to maximize value in a knapsack?
How are Huffman codes built from character frequencies?
What are overlapping subproblems and optimal substructure?
Compare memoization with the bottom-up table method.
How do I compute the longest common subsequence of two strings?
What's the DP recurrence for cutting a rod into pieces for max revenue?
How do I count the minimum number of coins to make an amount?
What order should I multiply a chain of matrices to minimize work?
How many single-letter changes turn one word into another?
How do I find the longest increasing subsequence?
Can a set of numbers be split into two halves with equal sums?
How many ways can I reach the bottom-right cell of a grid moving only right and down?
How do I check whether some subset of numbers sums to a target value?
